saw_lines: Natural skincare buyers choose by one ingredient and one routine, then reorder the same jar for months.
So the ad has to name the ingredient or routine in its first line, before the buyer scrolls past.
Your 30 ads carry no proof number, so new buyers get nothing to trust. Lead the next batch with one count, such as orders shipped, on the creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, so a buyer scrolling past has no evidence to trust. Collect one count, such as orders shipped, and open the next batch with it. Test it in two ads first.

3 of your 30 ads read as creator posts, yet run from the brand page. Buyers trust a personal voice, and a brand label blurs who is speaking. Whitelist those posts from the creator account and cut three variations of them.

None of your 30 ads gives a new buyer a first order offer, so there is no reason to act today. Two ads mention snail slime discounts, not first order deals. Lead three new ads with a first order offer.

15 different openings run across your 30 copy ads, and the biggest leads 5, so the batch competes with itself. Build the next batch from two stories only, the Julia role and the Longevity Code launch.

ads_1: Two new openers on the Longevity Code launch, plus a first order offer
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube
